full_name: Seema Alavi | Radcliffe Institute for Advanced Study at Harvard University
title: 2009–2010 History William Bentinck-Smith Fellow Jamia Millia Islamia (India)
bio: Seema Alavi is a professor of history at Jamia Millia Islamia in New Delhi, India. She specializes in medieval and early modern South Asia, with an interest in the transformation of the region’s legacy from Indo-Persian to one heavily affected by British colonial rule.
